users: researchers compiling quantitative literature cases with explicit provenance
not_intended_for: a validated benchmark, model-training data without case-specific review, or a claim that digitized and reported values are interchangeable with independent measurements

required_inputs: case-specific research question and inclusion criteria

limitations: Each case has separate data boundaries and evidence status.
Human-in-the-loop digitization and source metadata do not eliminate extraction or comparability uncertainty.
